thread:
Support: Hey team — Chantilly Health onboarding is hitting an intermittent auth failure during provisioning. Customer reports 50% of API calls returning 403s after key exchange. Marking urgent, possible renewal impact if not addressed by EOD.
Mira Chen: Thanks — can you drop request IDs or a snippet? cc @Alex Romero and @Grace (CS).
Support: Pasted a short sample: `req_20260321_42a7`, `req_20260321_42b1`. Error: `403 Forbidden - key mismatch`. Happened at 09:12 and 09:37 PT. No config changes on their side per support convo.
Alex Romero: Noted. I can run a quick token rotation check and validate KMS logs. @Samir Kaur can you confirm whether the private deployment certs rolled out last night?
Samir Kaur: We did a background cert refresh to the staging pool at 02:00 PT, not prod. Prod job was queued but failed on one node (error: `node-17 healthcheck`). Investigating now.
Grace (CS): Chantilly is mid-trial and flagged for renewal in 18 days. They escalated to their CTO already — we need a comms plan. I suggest: 1) Immediate status email to Chantilly lead with acknowledgement and ETA, 2) Hourly updates until resolved, 3) Postmortem + mitigation note before renewal touch. Who owns the customer-facing message?
Mira Chen: I can draft the initial email. Suggested wording: short, empathetic, mention we have an engineering task force on it, ETA 2 hours for first update. Approve?
Alex Romero: Approved. Also creating a temporary rule to route their requests to the alternative key-service (fallback) to reduce failures. Will post command when done.
support-bot: Incident created: INC-20260321-chantilly-auth. Priority: high. Assigned: eng-runtime (oncall) and cs-triage.
Samir Kaur: Found the node-17 cert push failed due to disk pressure during maintenance window. I'm re-running the rollout in a controlled batch and will watch KV sync. Expected time to finish ~30 mins.
Grace (CS): Great. Mira — please send the initial note to Chantilly lead and CC me. Include an optional scheduled 30-min war room at +45 minutes if they want a briefing.
Mira Chen: Sent initial email at 09:55 PT: "We're aware of intermittent 403s; engineering is investigating; next update in 1 hour; sorry for the disruption." Copying in: support ticket and incident link.
Alex Romero: Implemented temporary routing: `route: chantilly -> key-service-fallback`. Monitoring shows error rate dropped from ~48% to ~6% on their tenant.
Grace (CS): That improvement is helpful for the renewal conversation. I'll lock a provisional mitigation note in the renewal tracker and propose pushing the renewal call by 3 days to ensure full verification — ok to propose?
Jordan Patel: From account health side, recommend offering a one-week extension or credits if failures persist. We should coordinate legal on credit language.
Mira Chen: Got it — Grace, Jordan and I will sync after resolution to finalize offers.
Samir Kaur: Rollout completed; node-17 healthy; KV sync caught up. I see no further 403s in the last 10m for their tenant.
Support: Confirmed with customer — they see normal traffic again. Thank you.
Grace (CS): Closing loop: Mira to send a follow-up summary and Exec-facing note. Alex to write a brief engineering root cause summary for the postmortem. Samir to add the fix steps to the maintenance runbook. Jordan to draft credit language if needed. We'll reconvene in 24h for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
